import json, subprocess, sys
def raw(b):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=b,capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.strip()

base={"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}
def withmod(d):
    import copy; x=copy.deepcopy(base)
    for k,v in d.items(): x[k]=v
    return x

tests=[]
# duplicate key JSON
tests.append(('dupkey', b'{"zones":[],"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}'))
# nonfinite
tests.append(('nan', b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[],"x":NaN}'))
# extra root key
tests.append(('extra', json.dumps(withmod({"extra":1})).encode()))
# profiles empty
tests.append(('noprof', json.dumps({"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))
# bad name
tests.append(('badname', json.dumps({"zones":[{"origin":"te st.","records":[]}],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))
# CNAME at origin
tests.append(('cnameorigin', json.dumps({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"test.","type":"CNAME","data":"a.test."}]}],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))
# CNAME coexist
tests.append(('cnamecoex', json.dumps({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"CNAME","data":"b.test."},{"owner":"a.test.","type":"A","data":"1.2.3.4"}]}],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))
# duplicate origins
tests.append(('duporigin', json.dumps({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[]},{"origin":"TEST.","records":[]}],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))
# owner outside zone
tests.append(('outside', json.dumps({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"a.other.","type":"A","data":"1.2.3.4"}]}],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))
# bad A leading zero
tests.append(('bada', json.dumps({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"A","data":"1.2.3.04"}]}],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))
# bool max_aliases
tests.append(('boolint', json.dumps({"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":True,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))
# bad obs ref
tests.append(('obsref', json.dumps(withmod({"observations":[{"id":"o","query":"q","profile":"p","result":{"status":"timeout"}}]})).encode()))
# timeout extra key
tests.append(('timeoutextra', json.dumps(withmod({"observations":[{"id":"o","query":"q","profile":"p","result":{"status":"timeout","x":1}}],"queries":[{"id":"q","name":"a.","type":"A","cost":1}]})).encode()))
# depth >32
deep=b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[],"a":'+b'['*40+b']'*40+b'}'
tests.append(('deep', deep))
# aaa bad scope
tests.append(('scope', json.dumps({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"AAAA","data":"fe80::1%eth0"}]}],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode()))

for name,b in tests:
    rc,out=raw(b)
    ok = (rc==0 and out==b'{"error":"invalid-input"}')
    print(name, 'OK' if ok else 'FAIL', rc, out[:80])
